text: Crop insurance claim has not been processed in Haryana for 8 months leaving flood affected farmers in debt
Veterinary doctor is absent from the government animal hospital in UP for the last 3 weeks
Blood bank at district hospital in Assam has run out of supply and surgeries are being delayed
No ophthalmologist is available at the government eye hospital in Telangana
Students in Uttarakhand have not received free textbooks even though the session started 3 months ago
Principal of government school in Haryana is forcing students to do construction work instead of studies
Road connecting tribal village to main town in Maharashtra has been washed away in monsoon with no rebuilding
Streetlight maintenance budget in Telangana was sanctioned but no work has been done in 6 months
Hand pump installed under government scheme in Jharkhand is non-functional and has been for a year
Water treatment plant in Assam is non-operational and raw river water is being supplied to residents
Power supply to a tribal hamlet in Chhattisgarh is cut off for two months without explanation
Electricity department in Gujarat failed to respond to a complaint about meter tampering for 4 months
